_note: Words people say or type for each page, for the offline symptom finder (js/search.js). It never writes advice: it only opens these pages. Keys: a topic id (fever), a section of a topic (diarrhoea.zinc), a tool (tool/breaths, tool/reading/bp) or a screen (emergency, kit, near, family, children, adults). Lists: fa (Dari), ps (Pashto), lat (Dari or Pashto in English letters), en (English), danger (any language: these always come first, with a red badge; only on emergency pages and pages with a red box). A phrase starting with ? still needs a native speaker to check it. Spelling marks, ی/ي, ک/ك, ZWNJ and Persian digits do not matter. Write each phrase the way people say it; body part plus complaint (کمر درد) is better than one word.
